limitations: The benchmark is a short single-process local SQLite/WAL baseline with deterministic arrivals and a small read handler, not production traffic.
Distributed worker count, external calls, revocation, fan-out, failover, and multi-region behavior remain unverified.
The auditor role is adversarial and process-separated but not an external human or independently operated model.
The 20 ms p95 value remains an internal target; no production SLO or customer commitment is authorized.
note: research-plan PASS is a research evaluation; it never sets Goal ACCEPTED (release gate only)
